newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-KALNAPILIS PROFIT, SALES UP IN H1 97.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-KALNAPILIS PROFIT, SALES UP IN H1 97.

text.p: Lithuania's Kalnapilis brewery said on Thursday that its profit before taxes rose to 14.56 million litas in the first half of the year from 4.14 million litas in the same period in 1996.
The firm's finance director, Lina Markevichiute, also told Reuters that its sales rose to 34.44 million litas in the first six months of the year from 24.66 million litas in the same period in 1996.
"We increased our share of the country's beer market to almost 24 percent in the first half of the year from 19 percent in the same period in 1996," Markevichiute said.
In June, Kalnapilis topped the country's beer market in terms of volume with 355,000 decalitres sold.
"We have sold 1.38 million decalitres of beer during the first six months of the year, a 35 percent increase over the same period in 1996," Mackevichiute said.
Kalnapilis is owned by Baltic Beverages Holding, itself a joint venture of Hartwall and Pripps, part of Norway's Orkla .
The firm is listed on the A group of the Vilnius bourse.
